name: dp-it-giurisprudenza-anonymize
description: Anonymizes case-law plan files: Cassazione through the Italian NER + gazetteer + policy engine, CGT through a PII guardrail (flagged documents quarantined), cc unchanged. Files only, no DB.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item read <dirIn>/<stem>.plan.json and write <dirOut>/<stem>.plan.json with text_anon, ocr_dis_anon and a counts-only redaction_report. Failed items end the run with system_error.

items.description: the items to anonymize, as reported by the detect step

dirIn.description: directory with the convert plan files

dirOut.description: directory for the anonymized plan files

workers.description: Cassazione worker processes, each loads the model (default 1)

anonConfig.description: policy override: model, scoreThreshold, personLabels, typeToken, absoluteExtra, absoluteMateria, absoluteKw

output.description: { dirOut, processed: [{key, plan}], quarantined: [{key, id, reason}], metrics: {items, anonymized, passed_through, quarantined} }
